description:
FILED s532b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-06): the next cause of YAML-PP-v0.39.0-0 t/32.cyclic-refs.t once #4203 (Test::Builder->maybe_regex) let its warning_like row run -- `is($data->[0]->{link}->{link}, undef, "cyclic_refs=warn")` with `$data` undef from a failed eval.  PRE-EXISTING (59317afd the same).  LOUD (a raw host error, file aborted; the board row is the file's *PLAN* row, ran 2 of 8).

REPRO (scratch/s532b/pr/viv3.pl), perl 5.40.3:
    sub f { print scalar(@_), defined $_[0] ? "d" : "u", "\n" }
    my $d; f($d->[0]{a}{b}); print ref($d), " ", ref($d->[0]), " ", ref($d->[0]{a}), "\n";   # 1u / ARRAY HASH HASH
    my $e; f($e->[0]{a});    print ref($e), " ", ref($e->[0]), "\n";                         # 1u / ARRAY HASH
    my $g; f($g->{a}{b});    print ref($g), "\n";                                             # 1u / HASH
PCL: Unhandled simple-type-error ... Value of pcl::h in (sb-impl::gethash3 k h nil) is nil, not a hash-table.
The same chain as an RVALUE outside an argument list is right (`print defined($d->[0]{link}{link})` vivifies and answers u -- probed, viv.pl), so the bug is the ARGUMENT-slot (aliasing / deferred-element) path of a multi-level element chain: perl passes the last element as a deferred element (PVLV defelem) and vivifies every level above it; PCL's arg path reaches a NIL where the intermediate hash should have been created.  Find the argument lowering of an element chain (the #4086 aliasing-slot family, s532a: an element in an aliasing slot is a one-slot slice) and make every intermediate level vivify as the rvalue path does -- rule 11, one vivifying walker.
subject: A nested element chain through an UNDEF scalar passed as a sub ARGUMENT crashes with a raw SBCL error -- `my $d; f($d->[0]{a}{b})` dies "Value of pcl::h in (sb-impl::gethash3 k h nil) is nil, not a hash-table"; perl vivifies $d = [ { a => {} } ] (YAML-PP t/32.cyclic-refs.t row 3)
